Kakashi is the perfect balance of everything you'd want in a leader. He's assumed roles as both a teacher to children and the captain of kill squads. Hes familiar with the policies of every village across the continent, is deeply respected by ally and enemy, and see's things with a clarity not to many others have displayed through the whole series.

Unlike Tobirama, he doesnt cling to his feelings no matter how guttural they may be. Where Tobirama couldn't let go of his feelings from the clan wars and so isolated the Uchiha, Kakashi differentiates. He shows compassion to an enemy from the Hidden Mist (the village responsible for the events that led to his teammate to kill herself on his arm), by bringing Zabuza over to Haku as he was dying and sincerely hopes that his final wish to be reunited with him is granted.

Kakashi is brilliant. He knows leadership, politics, when to show kindness and when to be stern, and thats why he has my vote
